items.reason: Reports the same global canManage() check incorrectly accepting VIEW instead of requiring MANAGE.
Reports the same use of authorization resource UUIDs instead of resource names for permission lookup and returned group IDs.
Reports the same privilege escalation caused by canManage() accepting the all-groups VIEW scope.
Reports the same resource-ID versus group-ID mismatch in both hasPermission() and the granted set.
Reports the same incorrect Javadoc reference to canManageMembership instead of canManageMembers.
Reports the same Javadoc return description saying Stream when the method returns Set.

The alleged removal of per-user authorization matches none of the golden issues and is false at the PR head: searchForUser delegates to toRepresentation(), which still applies userModels.filter(usersEvaluator::canView).
